snippet.title: The Trial of Kharzoid - Paddle madness!
snippet.description:
I get asked the question if I will support the VAUS controller that came with Arkanoid. Multi-paddle levels like this make this impossible. I also make use of the 4 buttons and the VAUS only has 1 so we will have to stick with that good ol' NES controller!

The Trial of Kharzoid is an arkanoidvania for the NES set to release late 2023, early 2024.
